fields.description: An application must cover at least this many days (both dates included).
fields.label: Minimum Days per Application

fields.description: Students must apply this many days before the first day of absence. Approvers may still record late applications.
fields.label: Advance Notice (Days)

fields.description: Role that approves mess reduction applications. Hostel Wardens and Hostel Administrators can always approve.
fields.label: Approved By

fields.description: Total pending and approved reduction days allowed for a student in a calendar month. 0 means no limit.
fields.label: Maximum Reduction Days per Month

fields.description: Due date of the fee invoice raised for each mess bill, counted from the day the bills are published.
fields.label: Bill Due In (Days)

fields.description: Each student's bill total is rounded; the difference is recorded as a rounding adjustment.
fields.label: Bill Rounding

fields.description: Mess managers receive a weekly list of items at or below their reorder level.
fields.label: Send Weekly Low Stock Alert

fields.description: Goods that are not perishable can be received only against an approved indent, and no more than the approved quantity. Perishables (milk, vegetables, eggs…) can still be bought without one.
fields.label: Receive Stock Only Against Approved Indents

fields.description: Indents estimated above this amount must be approved by a Hostel Warden or Hostel Administrator. 0 means a Mess Manager may approve any indent raised by someone else.
fields.label: Warden Approval for Indents Above
